title: Silk Touch Harvest
description: Harvest spawners, trial spawners, cake & other "fragile" blocks with Silk Touch.
body:
# Silk Touch Harvest

A lightweight, config-driven Fabric mod for **Minecraft 1.21.1** that lets you
harvest blocks that normally drop nothing in vanilla — spawners, trial spawners,
vaults, cake, and more — using **Silk Touch**.

## Key features

- **Harvest spawners** with Silk Touch (drops an empty spawner, no XP).
- **Extract the spawn egg** from a spawner by right-clicking it with a
  configurable item (default: stick). The spawner is emptied and the matching
  egg goes straight into your inventory.
- **Fully configurable** — add or remove any block by ID, change the extraction
  item, and toggle each behavior in a simple config file.
- Works on **server and client**. Requires Fabric API.

## Default blocks

Spawner, Trial Spawner, Vault, Budding Amethyst, Cake, Turtle Egg, Sniffer Egg,
Frogspawn, Reinforced Deepslate — all editable in the config.
